data.summary: ddflow import on a TODO.md with 30000 checkboxes headlines 'Nothing to import' and adds 'Nothing recognisable was found... not necessarily wrong', right after the REFUSING (cap 200) line; the file WAS recognised. Repro: python generating 300 phases x 100 tasks, git init, ddflow import.
data.title: import over the task cap prints Nothing to import and Nothing recognisable was found after REFUSING

data.summary: In an empty non-git dir, 'ddflow onboard status' writes .ddflow/local/* (ticks, clone-id, flow samples) before failing 'brief exited 1: GitError: not a git repository' (exit 1); a read-only status should write nothing and say 'git init first'. import/preflight in git dirs write nothing (correct).
data.title: onboard status in a directory that is not a git repository creates .ddflow/local state and reports a raw GitError

data.summary: TODO.md lines '+ [ ] plus' and '1. [ ] numbered' (valid GFM task list items) are not imported and not counted in the left-out note; only '-' and '*' bullets are. Repro: throwaway repo with those lines, ddflow import.
data.title: import skips '+ [ ]' and '1. [ ]' checklist items silently

data.claim: onboard status/preflight and import (dry run) on a fresh throwaway git project report truthfully and write nothing; --apply twice is idempotent
data.falsifier: a fresh git repo gains files after status/preflight/import, or a second --apply imports again
data.mechanism: stages are read-only reports unless --apply; import dedupes by source
data.probe: throwaway git repo: ddflow onboard status; onboard preflight; import; import --apply twice
data.probe_output: ls -A stayed '.git' after each of the three read commands; second --apply printed 'Nothing to import'. Exceptions filed: B-onb-nogit-write (non-git dir), B-onb-cap-msg, B-onb-checkbox-forms
data.question: Does ddflow onboard + import take an unadopted repo from nothing to an honest report without writing to it?

data.summary: README.md line 191 lists onboard stages status, preflight, legacy, memory, test-gate, verify; the CLI has a seventh, harness. ddflow help onboard answers 'unknown help topic' (topics: cli config ... import ...), so the onboarding flow has no help page.
data.title: README onboard row omits the harness stage and 'ddflow help onboard' is an unknown topic

evidence.note: Research note R-bonboard-close CONFIRMED: fresh throwaway git repo gained no files from onboard status/preflight/import dry run; second import --apply printed 'Nothing to import'. Refuting observation (repo gains files / re-import duplicates) not seen.

13/13 tasks state done; completion shas verified ancestors of main via git merge-base --is-ancestor (12 recorded completed-as shas; B-onboard-command has no recorded sha, so its merge commit 6550ab8dd2 found by git log --grep was checked: ancestor). B-onboard-verify-hardening is not a B-onboard task.

Probed in throwaway projects, never this repo: empty git project, no-git dir, odd checkboxes (x/X/[-]/[]/nospace/empty/nested/unicode/duplicate title), 30000-task todo (refused at cap 200, 3 s), --apply twice (idempotent), unicode ids. Filed B-onb-cap-msg, B-onb-nogit-write, B-onb-checkbox-forms (all low); similar checked first, none found.
